description:
Return the saved AI tools ("My Workflow" stack) of the user who owns
    the given personal API key from thedailyworkflow.com.

    The user can generate the key on https://thedailyworkflow.com/my-workflow
    (section "Personal API key"). Ask the user for the key if you do not have it.

    Returns:
        Dict with `count` and `results`: each result has name, url (official
        site), page_url (catalog page), pricing and health (liveness status:
        alive / protected / slow / dead / unknown — re-checked every 4 hours).

    Use this when the user asks about "my tools", "my stack", "what did I save"
    in the context of TheDailyWorkflow.

api_key.description: Personal API key of the TheDailyWorkflow account, generated at https://thedailyworkflow.com/my-workflow (section "Personal API key"). It is sent as a Bearer token and selects whose saved tools are returned.
api_key.title: Api Key

name: get_my_saved_tools
